visual_prompt: Square 1:1 before/after ad in a glossy stylized 3D animated cartoon style, recreating the exact composition of the attached reference ad but with a different product, brand colors, character and texts. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. The product is a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; its black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white 'AGUAJE', the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' ('3 EN 1' in pink-red), a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes with '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. LAYOUT: vertical split screen. LEFT PANEL (about 38% of the width): deep plum-black background #2A0E22 with a soft dark vignette, dim and desaturated. At the top center of this panel, a small rounded pill in muted dark plum with the white word 'ANTES'. In the top-left corner, a small white hand-drawn scribble doodle. In the middle of the panel stands the BEFORE character: a young Latina woman with warm tan (trigueña) skin and long wavy dark-brown hair, rendered as a 3D cartoon, wearing pink athletic leggings and a matching pink sports top, standing in a three-quarter view (body turned about 45 degrees away from the camera so her hip and the side of her glutes are visible, face turned toward the viewer) with a sad, insecure expression; she is very slim, with very thin straight legs, narrow hips and flat glutes, the leggings slightly loose on her legs; framed from head to just below the knees. Down the left edge of this panel, three white handwritten notes stacked vertically, the first one with a small curved hand-drawn arrow pointing to her. A thick white curved arrow starts in the left panel at chest height and arcs into the right panel, pointing at the AFTER character's hip. RIGHT PANEL (about 62% of the width): vivid hot fuchsia background #E6177F glowing to bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 in the center and deep magenta #B0105E at the edges, with scattered white four-point sparkles and a few small white outline hearts. At the top left of this panel, a small rounded light-pink pill with the white word 'DESPUÉS'. Standing at the left-center of the right panel, slightly overlapping the split line, the AFTER character: the SAME woman with the same tan skin, the same long wavy hair and the same pink leggings set, the same three-quarter pose, now with a bright confident smile; the change must be obvious at first glance: a balanced, proportioned silhouette with visibly fuller, rounder and lifted glutes, wider curvy hips and thicker toned thighs, the leggings hugging her curves, natural and tasteful (not vulgar). In the top right of the right panel, a large left-aligned 4-line headline (white and yellow lines, ultra-heavy sans-serif caps with a soft dark drop shadow) and directly under it a 3-line white subtitle in a clean rounded sans-serif. On the right-middle, between the AFTER character and the product, three white handwritten notes stacked vertically, each accompanied by a small hand-drawn outline heart. In the bottom-right corner, the real product bottle, large (about 35% of the image height), upright, sharp and fully readable, with a large soft pink flower with glowing petals behind it at the right edge and a soft shadow at its base. At the bottom center, around the split line under the characters' legs, a round black seal with a thick metallic gold rim, three small gold stars along its top, a small gold shield with a check on its left edge, a big gold word and a smaller white line inside. Along the bottom of the right panel, centered between the seal and the product, a row of three thin-line white icons (a leaf, a capsule, a heart outline), each with a small white label underneath. Clean backgrounds, no noise, everything readable on a phone. Do not add CTA buttons, price badges, benefit lists, extra icons, extra badges, rating stars, bottom bars, discount labels, testimonials, logos, gym props or any text not listed.
